diagnosis.confidence: high_on_missing_evidence_and_explicit_assumptions; moderate_on_causal_failure_attribution
diagnosis.reason: A01/A02 use smaller female BMI residual loadings(.26 vs.32; .22 vs.34), whereas A03/A04 use larger ones(.36 vs.27; .40 vs.30). The latter reverse the observed negative interaction on all3 seeds. A05 uses more complex sex/age/BMI dependence and has1 positive/2 negative estimates. These are explicit unreported assumptions, not a failure to reproduce an available sex-specific slope.
diagnosis.alternatives: Feeding mixture, measurement scale, target demographic composition and omitted nonlinear dependence can also change projections. Existing data do not isolate these causal contributions.

analyses.smallest_followup: For a future use, seek sex-stratified continuous glucose-BMI covariance/slopes with the same age adjustment and compatible capillary/feeding definition. Until then present interaction outputs as scenarios. Keep HAALSI closed; no fitting to revealed interaction.
